text: Si ko kan laana ka yeddirɗaa mi sabu yulugol ka; hari ka wonanii lo'uɓe hiɓe gollera ka ka maayo ɓe hattantaake hiwugol ka, mi faalaa ko mi waɗi kon e makka yo wontan ka ayyibe; fii wata halor ka lamɗo wonɗo yeeso maɓɓe on, on jaɓtoowo kala laana moƴƴuka e junngo jom makka, o ɗala kala laana wonnduka e ayiiibe.
